about_preview.title: A Family Legacy in Construction
about_preview.text: Founded in 1985 in Bekalta, Tunisia, by pioneer contractor Mokhtar Fekih Romdhane. Today, his sons continue this proud legacy.

about.page_subtitle: A Family Legacy Rooted in Construction Since 1985
about.story_text: Fekih Romdhane Contracting was founded in 1985 in Bekalta, Tunisia, by pioneer contractor Mokhtar Fekih Romdhane. Starting with local construction projects, we have grown into a full-service contracting company executing major projects across Tunisia.
about.story_text2: Today, the founder's sons — Aymen, Achref, and Amine Fekih Romdhane — carry on the legacy, blending family heritage with modern construction technologies.

timeline.title: Foundation
timeline.desc: Pioneer contractor Mokhtar Fekih Romdhane founded the company in Bekalta with a vision to build modern Tunisia

timeline.title: First Expansion
timeline.desc: The company expanded to infrastructure and road projects across the Monastir region and Tunisian coast

timeline.title: Business Growth
timeline.desc: Hundreds of residential and commercial projects executed; workforce and equipment significantly expanded

timeline.title: Modernization
timeline.desc: The next generation joined, adopting the latest construction technologies and project management practices

timeline.title: Regional Leadership
timeline.desc: Became a leading reference in contracting along Tunisia's coastal region

timeline.title: Tunisia Tomorrow
timeline.desc: Continuing to build Tunisia's future with local expertise and over 41 years of experience
